Reminder FAQs

Will I get reminded every day?▾
Yes, once turned on, you'll get one notification per day at your chosen time.
Can I change the reminder time later?▾
Yes, just come back to this dashboard and pick a new time slot whenever you like.
What happens if I miss a reminder?▾
Nothing is lost — your words stay queued and your streak rules stay the same.
Do reminders work if the app is closed?▾
Yes, push notifications are delivered by the device even when the app isn't open.
How do I turn off reminders completely?▾
Toggle off "Daily quiz reminder" above, anytime.

Why Lexicon Works

How we help you in your progress

Every part of the app is built around one goal: making new words stick.

🎯

Personalized daily quiz

Five words a day, picked from your placement test result and current level.

🔁

Spaced repetition

Words you miss come back sooner; words you know well are reviewed less often.

📊

Progress dashboard

Track accuracy, streaks, and mastery breakdown at a glance.

🔥

Streaks & reminders

Daily push notifications keep your streak alive without extra effort.

🏆

See how your streak and score compare with friends and other learners.

☁️

Progress saved to your account

Log in once, and pick up your streak and word history on any device.

🧠 Mnemonic Learning

Turn tricky words into pictures and stories your brain won't forget.

Word: Gregarious (sociable)
Trick: Picture a "greGARIOUS" party — a GARDEN full of people, loud and social.
